name: Office Setup Variant 7
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to update 4 training manuals. Each manual: remove old section (pages 10-15), print new section (6 pages), insert and rebind. Supplies: 4 manuals, 24 sheets of paper, binder rings.

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.
